title: Dreamscape AI Official Music Video - House of Light - Kelly Boesch | 4K
description:
I made these images in #Midjourney experimenting with light, texture and movement. I knew these would animate well in #VEO3. I watched this video on my TV last night and it looks so good. Sets a nice mood. The song is called "House of Light" and it was made using Suno, my lyrics.
